top_signal.title: I Work in Custom Product Development in China. Looking for Advice.
top_signal.summary: Hi everyone,   I'm based in China, and I've spent the past several years helping overseas companies turn their product ideas into real, manufactured products.   My experience covers almost the entire process: finding and evaluating factories, product development, prototyping, negotiating costs, managing production, quality inspections, packaging, and international shipping.   I've worked on everything from collectibles and licensed merchandise to promotional products and custom consumer goods.   I speak English, can communicate directly with Chinese factories, and can travel to manufacturing facilities when needed.   I genuinely enjoy this work.     But here's where I'm struggling.     I'm currently unemployed, and despite having years of hands-on experience, I'm finding it incredibly difficult to connect with companies or individuals who actually need someone like me.    I've tried Upwork, built my own professional website, and put together a portfolio of my previous projects. I've spent a lot of time trying to present my experience professionally.   But having the skills and knowing how to get noticed seem to be two completely different things.   I'm not a factory owner or a trading company. I'm an individual who works on the client's side, helping them manage manufacturing in China and protect their interests throughout the process.   I'm not expecting anyone here to hand me a job.
